bushwick: Warm practical apartment light; ordinary daylight and neighborhood spill. Preserve bright sitcom readability in illustrated comic form rather than noir contrast or photographic realism.
dti: Flat fluorescent institutional light with toner-gray surfaces, stale-office fatigue, and clear readable faces; use illustrated comic lighting rather than live-action office-photo treatment.
silas: Over-lit LED-clean productivity aesthetic; sterile rather than futuristic, and still clearly illustrated.
museum: White clinical conservation lighting; dehumidified and invasive, but rendered as sequential comic art rather than photographic editorial imagery.
transitAndCivic: Harsh public lighting, scratched reflective surfaces, practical fixtures, no glamorization, and no photoreal transit-photography look.
exteriorNYC: Natural contemporary daylight/night practicals appropriate to location; keep the city recognizable and ordinary while remaining clearly drawn.
hearing: Municipal institutional lighting; restrained, clear, consequential, not courtroom melodrama and not live-action legal-drama photography.
